records.text: PAPSS and Interstellar launch the African Currency Marketplace on blockchain rails — direct African-currency-to-African-currency exchange, cutting the dollar out of the middle of intra-African trade and the five billion a year it costs. The same day, Morocco joins PAPSS as its seventeenth country.

records.text: The Rio summit presents the technical report on a BRICS cross-border payments system and targets a BRICS Pay pilot by end-2026 — while the 126-point declaration never once says "de-dollarization" and the common currency is quietly buried. Trump's 100% tariff threat killed the currency in one sentence; the plumbing survives because plumbing is deniable.
